On behalf of BrightPath Technologies, I am delighted to formally offer you the position of Senior Data Analyst, reporting to our Director of Analytics, David Chen.

- Base Salary: $118,000 per year, paid bi-weekly
- Signing Bonus: $5,000, payable within your first pay cycle
- Annual Performance Bonus Target: 10% of base salary
- Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage effective on your first day; 401(k) with 4% company match after 90 days
- Paid Time Off: 20 days annually, plus 10 company holidays
- Proposed Start Date: Monday, March 17, 2025

This offer is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and reference verification. Please review the attached offer letter and formal employment agreement. We would appreciate your response by end of day Friday, February 28, 2025.

We are all very excited about the possibility of you joining the BrightPath team and believe your experience will be a fantastic addition to our analytics group.

Warm regards,
Jennifer Alvarez
HR Business Partner
BrightPath Technologies
